cleanup.bannerBody: Please download {n, plural, one {# lesson} other {# lessons}} to your computer before {date}. After that, you will have to download all lessons before you can continue, and downloaded lessons are removed from the system.
cleanup.downloadAll: Download {n, plural, one {# lesson} other {# lessons}}
cleanup.confirm: Download {n, plural, one {# lesson} other {# lessons}} to your computer? Each lesson is a zip file starting with "Fluentia" and is removed from the system after downloading.
cleanup.overdueBody: System storage is still full. You need to download {n, plural, one {# lesson} other {# lessons}} to your computer. Each lesson is a zip file and is removed from the system after downloading. You can import it again with "Import from zip".
cleanup.multipleHint: If the browser asks to allow multiple downloads, choose Allow.
cleanup.failed: Could not download "{title}". It was kept.

login.title: Log in
login.googleDenied: This Google email has not been allowed by an admin.
login.googleFailed: Google login failed. Try again later.
login.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask an admin to reset it for you.

home.importInvalid: Invalid zip file. Use a zip downloaded with this app's "Download zip" button.
home.empty: No lessons yet. Click "New lesson" to start.

newLesson.heading: Create a new lesson
newLesson.title: Title (optional)
newLesson.subs: Subtitle file .srt or .vtt (optional; speech recognition is used if missing)
newLesson.uploadHint: Max 50 MB per file. The worker must be running on the computer to process the lesson.
newLesson.modeInputDesc: Type what you hear; the app checks and scores it.
newLesson.modeListenDesc: Listen only, no typing. Subtitles are shown so you can follow along.
newLesson.limitsHint: Suggestion: 20 sentences or 300 words is enough for one session. Keeps the first sentences until one of the limits is reached. Clear a box to keep the whole lesson.
newLesson.errLimits: Sentences and words must be positive whole numbers, or empty.
newLesson.errNoFile: Choose a video or audio file.

lesson.queued: Waiting for the worker. Start the worker on the computer.
lesson.processing: The worker is processing this lesson; it may take a few minutes.
lesson.downloadConfirm: Downloading the zip will DELETE this lesson from the system (the zip includes history and Shadowing recordings). You can re-import it with "Import from zip". Continue?
lesson.downloadFailed: Could not download the zip. The lesson was not deleted.
lesson.retranscribeConfirm: Re-transcribing deletes the current sentences and rebuilds them. The worker must be running. Continue?
lesson.dictationDesc: Listen to each sentence and type what you hear.
lesson.shadowingDesc: Hear the original, record your voice and play it back.
lesson.deleteConfirm: Delete this lesson with all its history and recordings?

editor.options: Sentence splitting and lesson size options
editor.regenConfirm: Re-splitting discards all current sentence edits. Continue?
editor.splitHint: Put the cursor inside the sentence where you want to split.

shadowing.title: Shadowing
shadowing.errMic: Cannot use the microphone. Allow microphone access (HTTPS required) and try again.

admin.title: User management
admin.hint: Username: 3-20 characters, lowercase letters, digits, underscore. Password: at least 8 characters.
admin.googleHint: Someone with this email who logs in with Google gets an account automatically. Removing an email does not delete an existing account.
